crossRefs.note: Passing by Mysia, they came down to Troas.
Setting sail therefore from Troas, we made a straight course to Samothrace, and the day following to Neapolis;
Now when I came to Troas for the Good News of Christ, and when a door was opened to me in the Lord,
Bring the cloak that I left at Troas with Carpus when you come, and the books, especially the parchments.

people.name: Troas
people.line: A city in Asia Minor, visited by Paul

translations.web: But these had gone ahead, and were waiting for us at Troas.
translations.bsb: These men went on ahead and waited for us in Troas.
translations.kjv: These going before tarried for us at Troas.
translations.asv: But these had gone before, and were waiting for us at Troas.
